name: WriteValueToRange
description: Writes one or more values to a specified range in a worksheet of an Excel file stored in OneDrive or SharePoint using the Microsoft 365 Excel API. Provide valid M365 credentials, the target Excel file's Drive and Item ID, worksheet name, range address, and the values to write. The connector will update the specified range and return the result, status code, and message from the API.
author: @gaurav

fields.name: __CredentialName__M365
fields.label: M365 Excel API Credential
fields.description: Credential for authenticating with Microsoft 365 Excel API (requires tenant ID, client ID, and client secret).

fields.name: DriveAndItemId
fields.label: Excel File (Drive and Item ID)
fields.description: The Drive ID and Item ID of the Excel file in OneDrive or SharePoint where the value will be written. Format: driveId/items/itemId.

fields.name: WorksheetName
fields.label: Worksheet Name
fields.description: The name of the worksheet in the Excel file where the value will be written (e.g., 'Sheet1').

fields.name: RangeAddress
fields.label: Range Address
fields.description: The address of the range in the worksheet where the value will be written (e.g., 'A1' or 'A1:B10').

fields.name: ValuesToWrite
fields.label: Values to Write
fields.description: The values to write to the specified range in the worksheet (e.g., [["Value1", "Value2"], ["Value3", "Value4"]]).

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Write Result
fields.description: Returns the result of writing the value to the specified range in the worksheet.
